first-in-line.name: First in line
first-in-line.html:
To complete the task, you need to visit the EMERCOM tent located in the southwest of the map near the extraction point.
After visiting, hand over 3 units of any medical item found in raid to the Therapist. Medicine can be found inside the tent.

 

EMERCOM Point on the map
Extractions on the map

 

To count the item as "found in raid", you must extract with the "Survived" status. To achieve this, gain several hundred XP in the raid (for example, kill two Scavs with headshots and loot them), or stay in the raid for seven minutes. Then leave the location via a valid extraction point.

 

The MES

The MES

shooting-cans.name: Shooting Cans
shooting-cans.html:
Eliminate any 5 targets (Scavs, PMCs) in the Ground Zero location. Take any available automatic weapon, for example,

PP-91 Kedr 9x18PM submachine gun
with
9x18mm PM Pst gzh
ammo and kill enemies. 

Look for Utes and AGS along the way, you need to find and visit them specifically as a PMC.


The machine gun is located in the Empire high-rise on the fifth floor through barbed wire on the stairwell. The staircase is on the Tarbank side.


Find the Empire building in Ground Zero
Find Utes in the Empire building



AGS is located in the Capital Insight high-rise on the second floor.


Find the Capital Insight building in Ground Zero
Find AGS in Capital Insight


Entrance to the Capital Insight building

Entrance to the Capital Insight building

burning-rubber.name: Burning Rubber
burning-rubber.html:
Since patch 0.16.8, you need to take 20000 rubles and you cannot put it in your pouch. If you die, you will need to get the money again. Go to Ground Zero

 

You must extract through the one-time paid vehicle exit. “Survived” status is not required. You can exit the raid immediately at the beginning and the quest will be completed.

 

Find the vehicle exit. It is located on the road to the right of the main entrance to the Terragroup building. The exit is a black SUV. Approach it and a context menu will appear — press “F”. A countdown will start. You don’t need to stay in the extraction area the whole time, just be inside it at the last moment.

 

Vehicle extraction on the map

 

Police checkpoint

Police checkpoint

rescue-the-mole.name: Rescue the mole
rescue-the-mole.html:
To complete the quest, head to the central TerraGroup building at Ground Zero .

 

Entrance to the parking lot at TerraGroup building
All important locations on the map

 

We are interested in the parking area and the main hall. In the parking lot, on the right side, you’ll find the first objective — PMC corpses. Approach them.

 

Entrance to the parking lot in the Terragroup building

Entrance to the parking lot in the Terragroup building

Place with PMC on parking lot

Place with PMC on parking lot

 

Next, head to the main hall and go to the elevator area. Under the rubble is a corpse. Inside the corpse is an

TerraGroup science office key
. It always spawns there; if it’s not present, another player has taken it. An explanation on how to access the room without a key follows.

 

The path to the elevators

The path to the elevators

Scientist with key

Scientist with key

 

Now go up to the second floor and open Room 4 on the right. If you don’t have the key, you can reach it via the ledge — go through Room 3, break the glass, and climb into Room 4.

 

Passage to the office where the HDD is located.

Passage to the office where the HDD is located.

Office where HDD is located

Office where HDD is located

 

The HDD has several spawn points, so carefully search the table to find it.

 

HDD in the locked office.

HDD in the locked office.

 

Exit and turn in the hard drive to the Mechanic.

debut.name: Debut
debut.html:
Go to any location and kill five Scavs. Ground Zero or Woods will be a good location choice for this. It is not recommended to go to Factory Killing Scavs while playing as a Scav does not count.


MP-133 12ga pump-action shotgun
can be found in several ways:


Level up your character to level 2. Accept the quest

Gunsmith - Part 1
, the quest
Introduction
opens for us, we complete it, open the Jaeger trader and buy two shotguns from him

Find in a raid. You can visit Factory as a Scav and find a corpse with an MP-133 shotgun


Scav with Saiga-9

Scav with Saiga-9

Scav with PP-Kedr

Scav with PP-Kedr

shortage.name: Shortage
shortage.html:
You need to find in raid or craft in the Hideout three Salewa first aid kits and hand them over to the Therapist. They can sometimes be found in medical bags.

It is recommended to go to Customs to the building with the library. On the second floor, there is a laboratory where medicine can spawn on tables and shelves.

 

Library with Laboratory on the map

 

You can also visit Reserve and go to the hospital (the building marked with a white chess bishop).

 

Medical loot in the hospital on the map

 

Another option is Interchange , where you can search in Mantis, TARZDRAV, and Pharmacy stores. Pay attention to tables and shelves in these stores.

 

"Mantis" on the map
"TARZDRAV" on the map
Pharmacy on the map

 

You may also go to Shoreline . The Health Resort has a lot of medical loot. It is located in the center of the location. Walk to the burning gas station by the shore and head in the direction opposite the sea. Below are open rooms in the Resort with medical bags or shelves.

 

Medical loot in the Health Resort on the map

 

East Wing: 102 — med. bag; 103 — shelf; 104 — med. bag and shelf; 228 — med. bag; 212 (entry through 211) — med. bag; 213 — med. bag; utility room (entry through 327) — med. bag.

West Wing: 103 — med. bag; 106 — shelf; 107 — shelf and med. bag; 110 — med. bag; 211 (on balcony) — med. bag; 320 (on balcony) — med. bag; 325 — med. bag; utility room (on balcony) — med. bag.

 

The Therapist will accept the kit even if it has only 1/400 durability.

luxurious-life.name: Luxurious life
luxurious-life.html:
This item is only visible to you, has several spawn points and can appear in different places in different raids. The quest can only be completed on the main character and will automatically complete upon reaching level 20.


Go to the Ground Zero location.


Go to the wine shop. It is located in the Skyside business center building.


Wine shop on the map



Bottle of wine on the map

background-check.name: Background Check
background-check.html:
First, you need to find

Machinery key
on Customs in the three-story dormitory, in room number 205 inside a jacket. Place it in a secure container.

 

Key to the fuel truck on the map

 

Jacket in the 205 room, in which is key

Jacket in the 205 room, in which is key

 

Next, you need to find the fuel truck at the construction site, open the driver's compartment using the special equipment key. At the bottom, between the pedals and the seat, you'll find the watch we need.

 

Fuel truck on the map

 

Bronze watch on the floor near the pedals

Bronze watch on the floor near the pedals

 

You just need to extract alive from the location and hand over the watch to the trader.

If you leave the location alive and enter the next raid without handing over the item and die in the new raid, the quest will have to be restarted.

gunsmith-part-1.name: Gunsmith - Part 1
gunsmith-part-1.html:
It is recommended to use a weapon with 100 durability, as the Mechanic might not accept a weapon with low durability.

 

Requirements: ergonomics over 47, laser sight, extended magazine (6 or more), total recoil below 850, occupies no more than 4 slots.

 

When completing the quest via the Flea Market, purchase all items listed in the table below:

Item Trader

Gunsmith - Part 1

Gunsmith - Part 1

the-tarkov-shooter-part-1.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 1
the-tarkov-shooter-part-1.html:
We buy any bolt-action rifle (for example,

Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Infantry)
) and go to any map to kill Scavs from a distance of 40 meters. It’s important to use a rifle without any sight attachments, except the standard iron sights. It is recommended to do this on the Woods location due to the presence of Scavs in open areas.

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Scav habitat on the map

the-tarkov-shooter-part-2.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 2
the-tarkov-shooter-part-2.html:
We buy any bolt-action rifle and equip any optical scope (for example:

Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Sniper)
,
Mosin Rifle Kochetov mount
,
PU 3.5x ring scope mount
, and
PU 3.5x riflescope
).

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

We go to the location Woods and shoot Scavs in the legs and head from 40 meters.

 

Scav habitat on the map

 

You can also try to complete this quest on Scav snipers (for example, at the hydro station on Shoreline ). PMC kills also count.

 

Scav sniper at hydro station

the-tarkov-shooter-part-3.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 3
the-tarkov-shooter-part-3.html:
We take any bolt-action rifle (for example,

Molot Arms VPO-215 Gornostay .366 TKM bolt-action rifle
with
.366 TKM AP-M
ammo) and go to the location Factory .

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Maps with intense indoor combat also work well (dorms on Customs , basements on Reserve ).

 

Completion speed may depend on luck (whether you encounter PMCs with good armor or not).

the-tarkov-shooter-part-4.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 4
the-tarkov-shooter-part-4.html:
We take any bolt-action sniper rifle, equip it with an optical scope (for example,

ELCAN SpecterDR 1x/4x scope
), and go to kill 5 PMCs from more than 80 meters.

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Since there are no restrictions on the location, you should choose whichever map feels most comfortable for ambushing enemies. Obvious options include Reserve near the weather station on the hill or Woods on the rocks.

the-tarkov-shooter-part-5.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 5
the-tarkov-shooter-part-5.html:
We buy any bolt-action rifle and go to the location Customs between 21:00 and 05:00 to kill Scavs.

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Scavs on the map

the-tarkov-shooter-part-6.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 6
the-tarkov-shooter-part-6.html:
You need to kill 5 Scav snipers with a bolt-action rifle.

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Scav snipers can be found on many maps, but there are specific locations where they appear.

 

On the Customs location, there are four snipers: building roof at the construction site; tall pipe near the railway embankment; roof of the building with the quest minibus; Scav checkpoint near the boilers.

 

Scav Snipers on the map

 

Customs: Scav sniper on the roof of the building, at the construction site

Customs: Scav sniper on the roof of the building, at the construction site

Customs: Scav sniper on a high pipe near the railway embankment

Customs: Scav sniper on a high pipe near the railway embankment


Customs: Scav sniper on the roof of the building, where there is a minibus on the quest Chemical. Part 4

Customs: Scav sniper on the roof of the building, where there is a minibus on the quest Chemical. Part 4

Customs: Scav sniper at a scav checkpoint near boilers

Customs: Scav sniper at a scav checkpoint near boilers

 

On the Shoreline location, there are two: roof of the hydroelectric station; cliff near the Scav checkpoint.

 

Scav Snipers on the map

 

Shoreline: Scav sniper on the roof of the hydroelectric power station

Shoreline: Scav sniper on the roof of the hydroelectric power station

Shoreline: Scav sniper on the rock at the checkpoint of the scav.

Shoreline: Scav sniper on the rock at the checkpoint of the scav.

 

On the Woods location, on the big rock in the center of the map.

 

Scav Sniper on the map

 

Woods: Scav sniper on a large rock, where the exit Cliff Descent is located.

Woods: Scav sniper on a large rock, where the exit Cliff Descent is located.

 

On the Streets of Tarkov location, several snipers: on the high-rise of the Cardinal Residential Complex; sniper on the roof of Klimov Trade House; one in the center of the map on the high-rise opposite the Pinewood hotel; on the roof of the LEXOS dealership; on the roof of the Rodina cinema.

 

Scav Snipers on the map

the-tarkov-shooter-part-7.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 7
the-tarkov-shooter-part-7.html:
You need to kill 5 PMCs from a distance of over 45 meters using bolt-action rifles with suppressors.

 

Buy any bolt-action rifle and equip a suppressor. Optics are optional.

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Recommended map for this quest is Woods . Take high ground or rocks and wait.

the-tarkov-shooter-part-8.name: The Tarkov shooter - Part 8
the-tarkov-shooter-part-8.html:
Before starting this quest, it is recommended to level up Sniper Rifles skill to level 2.


As a reward, you will receive sniper skill levels, which will make it easier to complete quests

Wet Job. Part 6
,
Psycho Sniper
, and
Make an Impression
, as they require sniper skill progression.

 

For the kill objective, you must eliminate 5 PMC players in one life — it can be done across different raids.


After the kills, you must survive and extract.

 

Take any bolt-action rifle, go to any location, find a position, and start shooting PMCs.

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

It is recommended to complete this quest alongside

Psycho Sniper
.

introduction.name: Introduction
introduction.html:
Head to Woods. Near the crashed plane, there will be a small wooden tower. Underneath it, you’ll find a letter you need to pick up.

Grab the letter, extract from the location, and hand it over to the Mechanic.

Find the hunter’s camp on the map

Jaeger’s parking lot, near the wrecked plane

Jaeger’s parking lot, near the wrecked plane


Message from the Jaeger under the wooden tower

Message from the Jaeger under the wooden tower

acquaintance.name: Acquaintance
acquaintance.html:
A huge amount of food can be found on Interchange in the Goshan store, at the dead end on the shelves.

The "Iskra" ration pack can be crafted in the Hideout.

Noodles spawn at food spots. It’s best to look for them in Woods and among Scavs.

Food can be found in duffle bags, on dead Scavs, etc.

Find provisions on Interchange

“Goshan” store at the Interchange

“Goshan” store at the Interchange


Recommended loot area for food

Recommended loot area for food

the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.name: The survivalist path - Unprotected, but dangerous
the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.html:
Take any weapon with optics and go to the Woods location. As soon as you spot a Scav from a long distance, take off your armor and kill him.

 

If the Scav spots you first, do not remove your armor.

 

Armored rigs count as armor.

 

Scav spawns on the map

the-survivalist-path-thrifty.name: The survivalist path - Thrifty
the-survivalist-path-thrifty.html:
Buy two

Bottle of water (0.6L)
and two
Iskra ration pack
, then head to the Woods location.

 

Your destination is the underground bunkers, which are marked below.

 

You need to place the items into the broken box.

 

Bunkers on the map

 

Entrance to ZB-016

Entrance to ZB-016

Spots for placing items in ZB-016

Spots for placing items in ZB-014

the-survivalist-path-zhivchik.name: The survivalist path - Zhivchik
the-survivalist-path-zhivchik.html:
Lower your hydration to 0 during a raid using food.

Jar of DevilDog mayo
works best, or use multiple
Analgin painkillers
. Also bring
Bottle of water (0.6L)
and a medkit —
IFAK individual first aid kit
is enough.

 

Go to the Shoreline location at night, sit in the nearest bush, reduce your hydration, and stay for 5 minutes. Once the subtask is counted, drink the water.

 

Extract from the raid alive.

the-survivalist-path-wounded-beast.name: The survivalist path - Wounded beast
the-survivalist-path-wounded-beast.html:
Lower your hydration to 0 during a raid using food.

Jar of DevilDog mayo
and
Army crackers
work best. Also bring
Bottle of water (0.6L)
.

 

Consume the food, wait about 30 seconds until the screen starts to blur and the pain shock effect appears, then kill Scavs. Once enough Scavs are killed, drink the water.

 

Do not use medical items that provide pain relief (e.g.

Analgin painkillers
), as they will remove the pain shock effect and Scav kills will not count.

 

It is recommended to complete this quest on the Woods location.

the-survivalist-path-tough-guy.name: The survivalist path - Tough guy
the-survivalist-path-tough-guy.html:
Take any weapon with an optical sight and go to the Woods location. Choose any position where Scavs spawn and stay put to minimize the risk of taking damage.

 

You are not allowed to use any medical items. No medkits, no splints, no painkillers, etc.

 

Even after killing three Scavs, do not use any medicine — the quest will fail.

 

If you kill three Scavs in a single raid without using medicine but die afterward, the quest will not fail.

 

Scav spawns on the map

the-survivalist-path-cold-blooded.name: The survivalist path - Cold blooded
the-survivalist-path-cold-blooded.html:
We lower hydration in the raid to 0 using food.

Jar of DevilDog mayo
and
Army crackers
are more suitable. Also bring
Bottle of water (0.6L)
with you.

 

Eat the food, wait half a minute until the tremor effect appears (your character’s hands will shake when aiming), and then kill PMCs with headshots. After killing enough PMCs, drink water.

 

It is recommended to complete this quest on the Factory location.

the-survivalist-path-eagle-owl.name: The survivalist path - Eagle-owl
the-survivalist-path-eagle-owl.html: It is recommended to kill Scavs at night between 21:00 and 04:00 on the Interchange location. The Ultra mall is well-lit at night. You can also go to the Streets of Tarkov location.

the-survivalist-path-combat-medic.name: The survivalist path - Combat medic
the-survivalist-path-combat-medic.html:
Vitality increases when the character takes damage. You can find a secluded spot with barbed wire and take damage from it (a burning barrel or jumping from heights also works), healing yourself in between.

 

Don’t forget that fatigue can reduce skill gain, so try to earn a small amount of Vitality experience per raid and then start a new one.

huntsman-path-the-trophy.name: The Huntsman path - Trophy
huntsman-path-the-trophy.html:
The boss Reshala appears on the Customs location. He can be found: in the dorms; at the new gas station; at the construction site near the railroad; in warehouse building number 4.

 

He is accompanied by 4 well-equipped Guards. The boss himself wears no armor. You must kill him and take from him the

TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden)
. This pistol must be found in raid.

 

You may be unlucky – when you kill Reshala, he might not have the required pistol. You can use the Sectant Circle. Place one

Reshala figurine
and send it. The Sectants will bring you
TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden)
, and you can turn it in for the quest.

 

Remember, you cannot place the pistol in your secure container. You must extract alive from the location. Have 5000 rubles just in case, to use the vehicle extract if you killed Reshala at the dorms.

 

Boss spawn points on the map

huntsman-path-woods-cleaning.name: The Huntsman path - Forest cleaning
huntsman-path-woods-cleaning.html:
You need to kill 30 Scavs on any location.

 

It is recommended to do this on Interchange or Streets of Tarkov .

huntsman-path-controller.name: The Huntsman path - Controller
huntsman-path-controller.html:
Buy

TOZ KS-23M 23x75mm pump-action shotgun
and craft star flash rounds in the Hideout. Take the weapon you will use to kill PMCs and head to Factory .

 

Try to close the distance to PMCs, blind them, switch to your main weapon, and eliminate them.

 

If you can't craft flash rounds, try killing PMCs using

Model 7290 Flash Bang grenade
.

huntsman-path-justice.name: The Huntsman path - Justice
huntsman-path-justice.html:
You need to kill three of Reshala's Guards. So, head to the Customs location and check Reshala’s spawn points.

 

Boss spawn points on the map

huntsman-path-evil-watchman.name: The Huntsman path - Evil watchman
huntsman-path-evil-watchman.html:
Head to the Customs location to kill PMCs in the dorms area.

 

PMC kill zone on the map

the-survivalist-path-junkie.name: The survivalist path - Junkie
the-survivalist-path-junkie.html:
Take any stim or consumable that boosts stats (for example,

Propital regenerative stimulant injector
or
Can of Max Energy energy drink
). Head to the Woods location.

 

When you spot a Scav, use the consumable and kill it. While the positive effect is active on your character, try to find and kill as many Scavs as possible.

 

Scav spawns on the map

claustrophobia-quest.name: Claustrophobia
claustrophobia-quest.html:
You can use any shotgun for the kills (for example,

MP-153 12ga semi-automatic shotgun
). You may eliminate both PMCs and Scavs.

 

Head to Factory and go to the underground corridors. The entire basement counts, except for the central area with the three tankers.

 

Enemy kill zone on the map

rough-tarkov.name: Rough Tarkov
rough-tarkov.html:
To complete the task, you must visit mined areas on two locations.

 

The mine zone near the USEC camp on the Woods location:

 

The area with mines near the USEC camp.

The area with mines near the USEC camp.

 

Mined area near the USEC camp on the map

 

The room with a mine on the Ground Zero location (Do not try to open the safe – you will die):

 

The room with the Claymore

The room with the Claymore

 

Claymore in the Empire building on the map

 

WARNING. Mines can detonate and kill you. If you step on one by accident and it explodes, do not turn around — just go back the same way.

 

The Claymore in the Empire building kills INSTANTLY. Carefully approach the room until the quest is counted, then leave.

every-hunter-knows.name: Every Hunter Knows This
every-hunter-knows.html:
The first location is at Factory , on the 3rd floor in the room where you need to break the door. Go upstairs and enter – this will complete part of the quest.

 

Room on the map

 

The right door for the quest. It is required to knock out

The right door for the quest. It is required to knock out

 

The second stash location at Customs is in the three-story dorm building, on the staircase by the window.

 

Spot by the window on the map

 

Mining place in 3-story dormitry near window

Mining place in 3-story dormitry near window

work-smarter.name: Work Smarter
work-smarter.html:
Enter the location Customs , then you need to enter the area of effect of one of the two secret extracts on this location. You don’t need to extract or find the note.

 

Secret extracts on the map

 

Smuggler's boat

Smuggler's boat

ZB1012

ZB1012

rite-of-passage.name: Rite of Passage
rite-of-passage.html:
You need to kill 10 Scavs at each gas station on the Customs location.

 

Kill zone at the old gas station
Kill zone at the new gas station

 

Metal fuel tank
can be found in duffle bags and hidden stashes

 

Fuel canister on the map

huntsman-path-secured-perimeter.name: Huntsman path - Secured perimeter
huntsman-path-secured-perimeter.html:
Head to the Factory location and go to the office area. The office zone includes all three floors of the building, as well as the stairwells and the basement.

 

The enemy must be killed within this zone. Your own position during the kill does not matter.

 

PVE Tip: Try staying in the office area through multiple raids until the red timer appears — this increases your chance of encounters.

 

PMC kill zone on the map

shootout-picnic.name: Shootout picnic
shootout-picnic.html:
Go to the Woods location and eliminate fifteen Scavs, which can be found all over the map.

 

Below is a map showing Scav spawn areas. Kills made while playing as a Scav do not count. The boss Shturman and his guards also count toward the total.

 

Scavs on the map

sanitary-standards-part-1.name: Sanitary Standards. Part 1
sanitary-standards-part-1.html:
Gas analyzer
is best searched for on Interchange in the OLI store. In the center of the store, closer to the checkout area, there are several shelves where it can be found.

 

Gas analyzer spawn locations in OLI on the map

 

If you’re unlucky, visit electronics stores: Techno Spectrum, Rasmussen, German, TTS, IDEA storage, TECHLIGHT, and Power Station offices. In these stores, check shelves, tables, racks, etc.

 

Electronics spawns where gas analyzer can appear on the map

 

Even if you don’t find a

Gas analyzer
, there’s still a high chance to find useful Hideout items, making the raid worthwhile.

 

There’s no need to access the pump station.

 

You will need two more gas analyzers found in raid for a future quest, so if you find extra ones — take them.

 

Containers where a gas analyzer can spawn on the map

 

You can also craft it in the Hideout.

grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.html:
There are few options on how to complete this quest. 

Option 1. 
Find

RGO hand grenade
or
RGN hand grenade
in grenade boxes .
Those are active grenades that explode on contact with surface after 0.3 seconds delay. A fool-proof mechanism is in place so a minimum distance of 5 meters is required. If you are not familiar with those mechanics - better to test in offline mode first.
Next we go to Factory . Select a nade, cook it and wait for enemy in narrow corridors.
It is best to look for grenades in these locations:
On the map Reserve
On the map Lighthouse
On the Streets of Tarkov

Option 2. 
Get any armor with hand protection and full helmet (which protects your whole head). Get some nades with you (preferably
F-1 hand grenade
, but
RGD-5 hand grenade
is alright too). If you have lots of cash -
VOG-17 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
or
VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
will be better due to lowest explosion timer. Next step is again - Factory ! Play map as normal, but when you meet someone with no armor/low tier weapon or a hatchling, shoot their legs and try to finish them off with a nade.

If you've hear any automatic rifle or shotgun fire - high chance this is a boss and he doesn't like nades being thrown, so better bail quickly (or kill him if you are confident!). Always carry
Factory emergency exit key
with you for quick getaway.

Option 3.
If you don't like active gameplay or Factory is not a map of your likings, there is always an option of carrying few cheap nades (
F-1 hand grenade
or
RGD-5 hand grenade
) with you every raid. Try to use them often when fighting other players and eventually you will complete it.

-----

  • Another way: use
    Tripwire installation kit
    . You can get this from Jaeger’s easy quests
    Rough Tarkov
    . Place tripwires in difficult or dark spots. Best to use
    VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
    as it has the shortest fuse. Place them in bushes, on stairs, or crossings - where running is not possible, only walking. Tripwire + VOG cost about 65,000 rubles.

    Kills with
    Milkor M32A1 MSGL 40mm grenade launcher
    ,
    GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher
    and
    M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher
    are not counted

TASK IS COMPLETED IN EFT: ARENA

Caution: You should transfer money before entering Arena
You also need to win 3 out of 6 matches in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint modes.

If you lose 4 matches — the task will fail.

We recommend playing in TeamFight.

create-distraction-2.name: Create a Distraction. Part 2
create-distraction-2.html:
Your path leads to the Streets of Tarkov.
According to the quest description, killing Kollontay’s guards in the Epicenter may not count, but it might still work.

To complete the quest, you need to kill just two guards from any of the following bosses. Do not kill the bosses themselves, or the quest will fail.

Kaban has personal bodyguards – Goose and Basmach – they do not count as regular guards.

Guide for Kaban – Kaban Kaban guide ... 26.01.24
Guide for Kollontay – Kollontay Kollontay Guide ... 26.01.24

Kaban is easy to identify – big guy with a heavy machine gun. Do not shoot him.

Kollontay looks like a riot police officer. He’s harder to recognize, especially for new players.
If you're unsure, try shooting at different body parts – Kollontay has unique voice lines that differ from regular bots and guards.
Important: Don’t kill the bosses themselves, or the quest will have to be restarted.

huntsman-path-factory-chief.name: The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief
huntsman-path-factory-chief.html:
The boss Tagilla spawns with a certain chance on the Factory location.

 

It’s best to complete the quest with a friend — Tagilla chases him with a sledgehammer, allowing you to shoot him in the unprotected back of the head.

 

The boss is very aggressive and starts shooting immediately. The best tactic is to get as close as possible so that he switches to the sledgehammer and starts chasing you.

 

Since the boss wears class 4 and 6 armor, it’s best to use high-penetration, high-damage ammo.

 

His only protected areas are the head (excluding the back) and chest, so you can try to kill him with buckshot to the stomach or legs (be careful — Tagilla ignores broken legs and will continue to chase you even after multiple shots to them).

 

BOSS cap
spawns on the boss with a 100% chance. If you kill the boss but can’t extract the cap, try checking Scav players — one might have it.

huntsman-path-woods-keeper.html:
Shturman lives in the Woods at the sawmill. Has a retinue of two snipers. The boss himself has no armor. The retinue mainly has class 4 armor, but does not wear helmets. They try not to be close to each other and keep their distance from the player. At medium and long distances it is useless to fight them; they shoot very accurately. It is best to carefully move from the lake from the part with the hangar with logs, checking every corner, hangars, temporary shelters at the sawmill and kill them at close range. Also catch them when they retreat. They act stupid when the enemy is at point-blank range

a-shooter-born-in-heaven.html:
Before starting this quest, it is recommended to level up to Sniper Rifles mastery level 2. The reward includes Sniper Rifle mastery levels, which will make it easier to complete quests

Wet Job. Part 6
,
Psycho Sniper
, and
Make an Impression
, as they require sniper rifle mastery levels.

To complete this, take any bolt-action sniper rifle you prefer (Mosin Rifle, SV-98, DVL-10, Remington M700, ORSIS T-5000M, VPO-215 "Gornostay", AMXC) and aim for headshots on PMCs.

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

Since distance doesn’t matter, you can wait at busy or quest-related locations (ideally where players are placing quest items so they stand still), or, if skilled, engage in close combat.

dragnet.name: Dragnet
dragnet.html:
To get into the warehouse, you need

TerraGroup storage room keycard
. It can be obtained from Cultists (or on the Flea Market).


We recommend running Customs , as there is only one area inhabited by Cultists. The exact time Cultists appear is from 23:00 to 05:00. The time frame might be extended, but this is the time they were definitely present. Consider the raid search time and launch in advance.


On this date, the current chance of Cultists spawning is 20%. Bring

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
to quickly exit at the Railway Exit , whether you found Cultists or not.


Bring night vision goggles!

Cultists are always in the bushes, they are hard to see but easy to hear - they switch from long-range weapons to knives and back. After you kill at least one cultist, the others will rush you, but with long-range weapons. They always have the best and most powerful ammunition, as well as high accuracy. They are very dangerous in open combat, so play from cover. They don’t always die from one shot to the head. They shoot through bushes!


The required quest keycard can be with any cultist. Not just the Priest. Even with a regular Cultist in their backpack. Most often, the keycard is in the Priest’s pocket (the Priest is a Cultist with huge pockets, unlike others) - the last slot in the pocket. There will be either an intel item, a key, or a keycard. The keycard can also be in the backpacks of other cultists. There are usually 3 to 4 Cultists in total, including the Priest. If the Priest remains the last one, he will run away from you and then blow himself up with a grenade somewhere in the bushes. Be sure to search everyone!


After obtaining the card, go to the Factory.

iron-authority.name: Iron Authority
iron-authority.html:
The Minotaur is actually Tagilla who carries a special axe
He is very strong and wears Class 6 armor on both chest and helmet
He can be found in the center of the Labyrinth map

Sometimes Killa may spawn along with the Minotaur
He is also strong and will interfere

You have two options

Use the most armor-piercing rounds and aim around the head

Use decent rounds and shoot the legs or hope to penetrate the helmet

Shoot from around corners and do not push him directly
When the boss charges at you back off
He will kill you instantly in close combat

The boss’s guards are raiders with ancient names
They are quite weak but will get in the way
It’s not hard to kill them but if there are other PMCs in the raid you probably won’t complete the quest on your first attempt

clear-the-room.name: Clear the room
clear-the-room.html:
Put on your best gear and weapons — you're heading into the Labyrinth.

Don't forget to bring a Keycard for entry and a multitool.

There are few players in the Labyrinth, and those who are there often wait until the very end — to kill the remaining PMCs and take everything for themselves. Be extremely careful.
If you're playing in a group, there will be fewer enemies. The Labyrinth allows up to 5 players — friends or foes, it doesn't matter. Maximum 5 players total.
If you're in a full group, all 5 allies will spawn together without enemy PMCs.
Stock up on keycards in advance.

the-huntsman-path-big-game.name: The Huntsman Path - Big Game
the-huntsman-path-big-game.html:
The boss Kaban is not the most difficult boss in the game, but he has his own features.

The main feature is that he has only one spawn point – inside the LEXOS car dealership.

It’s a small fortress with machine guns and an automatic grenade launcher. He has a squad of strong NPCs and assistants. All are well-equipped and have lots of health.

Snipers are often on the roof! The roof is on the left, right, and the bridge between roofs.

Machine guns are aimed at the gate, so you can't just walk in. You either need to kill the gunners or throw a grenade — to kill them or force them to flee.

The best way to enter the LEXOS area is to throw a grenade toward the gunner. This way you either kill or scare them off and can rush in to take position.

If you enter from Chekannaya Street, we recommend taking position to the left of the entrance inside the container. From there, you can carefully aim and kill the Boss’s guards or Scavs. BEWARE OF THE MACHINE GUN. Bots will try to sit behind it to shoot. You can shoot them while they run for it.

If you enter from Scout Street, run to the right into the small building.

The boss Kaban himself is found inside the building on the left (LEXOS sales office) or right (garage box). Sometimes, he can be outside. Killing him isn’t very hard, but often he shoots at you “seeing” through walls. The easiest way to kill him is while he’s running — either toward you or from a grenade. It takes a lot of bullets to kill him, but he’s simple overall.

His corpse contains 100-round machine gun magazines and keys to the second floor of LEXOS — one of them is single-use, needed for future quests.

huntsman-path-eraser-part-1.html:
The boss Glukhar resides on the Reserve location and is accompanied by six well-armed guards.

 

They have heavy armor and high health, so killing him will require a lot of high-penetration ammo.

 

You’re lucky if you encounter him in the barracks (Black Pawn) or the school building (Black Bishop). The easiest way to kill him is at close range in narrow corridors by camping in one of the rooms.

 

If you run into him near the technical repair points (Knight), it’s best to approach from behind the buildings to avoid stepping into open ground.

 

The worst case is encountering him at the unloading station near the depot (K). It’s the most inconvenient place to kill the boss. There are many angles he can shoot through. You can try using the AGS mounted on one of the bunkers (E2).

 

The boss can also spawn in the underground areas near the path leading to the hermetic bunker door.

 

The closer you get to Glukhar, the higher your chances of killing him. If he spots you from a distance, you’ll have no chance.

above-your-head.name: Above your head
above-your-head.html:
Bring good gear and weapons and head into the Woods location.
Encounters may be random, or you can wait for enemy PMCs at points of interest, such as the Lumber Mill or the EMERCOM camp.
You need to kill two PMCs in a single raid.

swift-retribution.name: Swift retribution
swift-retribution.html:
The quest may appear after entering any raid or restarting the game.

It's simple — you need to kill 10 Scavs. Take your preferred weapon and gear, and go. Other players will interfere, so be careful.

The reward is a special key. The key opens a door in the depot area — a house at the bottom of the map. There are many valuable items and intel items inside. Bitcoins on the beds, intelligence folders on the shelves, disks on the floor, on shelves, and in the toilet.

The bunker is located in the center of the Forest map, under a large mountain.

You need to collect 3 packs of Russian-made armor-piercing cartridges (5.45x39, 7.62x39, etc.). These ammo packs can be bartered from Prapor. If you don't have them and can't buy them, you can also find the required ones on the Forest map without much difficulty.

Find ammo packs on Woods


Attention! Ammo packs cannot be placed in the secure container! If you die, you will lose them.
Do not open the packs — otherwise you won't be able to plant them.

Ammo packs that are confirmed to work as of 21.01.25:

5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
,

The path is long, but the reward is priceless. Everything must be done within a single raid session. You need to kill at least 10 any targets along the entire route, otherwise the task will fail and you'll have to start over.

city-gendarme-interrupted-session.html:

HK MP5 9x19 submachine gun (Navy 3 Round Burst)
, modify it, bring plenty of ammo and grenades. Load into the Streets of Tarkov location and head to the Rodina cinema area to kill Scavs.

 

Lure them by shooting inside the cinema without a suppressor and by using grenades.

 

Scavs usually spawn under the bridge or at the entrance to the cinema. If they spawn near the fountain and don't come your way, just kill them and wait for the next wave.

samples.name: Samples
samples.html:
The best way to complete this quest is to buy

TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
on the flea market. Then take
TerraGroup Labs access keycard
, go to The Lab , and enter the experiment room. All required stimulants can spawn on the floor, chairs, boxes, and examination couches.

 

You can complete quest

Colleagues - Part 3
to receive
TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
as a reward for access to the lab room. This quest also requires finding stimulants, but it’s easier to complete. If you can't complete it, do
Gunsmith - Part 25
to trade with Mechanic for the black keycard.

 

Less reliable methods to find stimulants: in the backpacks of Sanitar and his guards; from Scav players (or playing as a Scav); use

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)
on an open map and hope for a medical airdrop; or wait for your Scav to spawn with the required syringe in inventory.

 

These were general tips. Now let’s go over each stimulant:

M.U.L.E. stimulant injector
,
3-(b-TG) stimulant injector
,
Meldonin injector
: on Lighthouse , behind the Rogues’ base lab in container , medical bags.

Obdolbos cocktail injector
: Medical locations in Woods : EMERCOM, USEC camp, covered hangar at the lumber mill

AHF1-M stimulant injector
: many players struggle with this stimulant. Sadly, it has no fixed spawn. See the general tips above.

P22 (Product 22) stimulant injector
: reward from quest
Colleagues - Part 2

L1 (Norepinephrine) injector
: Tagilla, useful spots on Lighthouse , lab on Lighthouse

You need to kill PMCs with the MP5SD on the Streets of Tarkov , Ground Zero , or Interchange maps.

huntsman-path-crooked-cop.html:
Kollontay is one of the bosses on the Streets of Tarkov map.
His locations are the MVD Academy or Klimov Trading House.
Find on the map
Kollontay is often found sitting inside the mentioned buildings and attacks players through windows while his guards push the target.
His guards are four bots, have Raider AI, and act as assault units. They may wear armor and helmets up to class 5, but their visors are usually no higher than class 3.
Kollontay himself has 300 health in the torso and 65 in the head, so it's recommended to eliminate him with precise headshots. His only head protection is a firefighter helmet with level 2 armor, so there shouldn't be any issues penetrating it with most mid-tier rounds.
Beware of close combat with Kollontay because of the "Panic" effect he can apply to the player while using his police baton. This effect will cause your current weapon to jam.

Go to the flea market and search for

For the second vest, set the “Condition” filter to 0%–49%. If the price is good, buy it.

 

If the damaged vest is too expensive, buy one in full condition, equip it, and go to the Customs location at night.

 

Head to the dorms. On the first and second floors you’ll find explosive cylinders. Stand about 4–5 meters away and shoot them. The damage should not be critical to you, but the vest will lose durability. Repeat this process 6–7 times, then turn the vest in to the trader.

 

Alternatively, let Scavs shoot at you with non-lethal weapons (e.g.,

TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol
) to reduce durability, or ask a friend to shoot your armor until it’s damaged enough.

hell-on-earth-2.name: Hell on Earth. Part 2
hell-on-earth-2.html:
To complete the task, you need to eliminate three cultists using

MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun
. Prapor will provide the initial one; if lost, buy it yourself. Recommended ammo is
12/70 8.5mm Magnum buckshot
, aim only for the head.

 

Cultists only appear at night on the following maps: Shoreline , Woods , Customs , Factory (Nighttime), and Ground Zero (after level 20). From approximately 23:00 to 06:00.

 

Spawn chance is higher on Shoreline , Woods , and Customs . On Factory and Ground Zero they are almost impossible to find. Cultists are a boss. A group consists of four cultists and the leader Priest. At sunrise they despawn (disappear). Other bosses can prevent Cultists from spawning (for example, if Reshala spawns at construction, Cultists won’t appear until Reshala and his guards are fully eliminated).

 

They usually sit or lie in bushes waiting for someone to approach. They first attack with a knife, but if you shoot them first or kill their leader, they immediately open fire. If you kill the entire group, the Priest may try to blow himself up with a grenade.

 

On the Customs map, you can kill them by holding the sarcophagus building. It’s very convenient to use cover inside. One advantage is that they will sometimes push you indoors.

 

At long range, there’s little point engaging them without a thermal scope (they are visible through thermal optics).

 

On Shoreline , it is recommended to kill them near the hydroelectric station. Just climb the nearby hill and shoot them from above. Keep more than 100 meters away from them.
You can also try to kill them at the sanatorium. Sometimes they appear inside on the first floor and outside, except for the admin building. They can also be found at the flooded village.

 

The Woods location is highly discouraged for killing Cultists. Large open spaces, bushes, and trees make it nearly impossible to fight them effectively.

 

On the Factory map, they appear in all locations where Scavs can spawn. They can be in the basement or offices. If Cultists are in the raid, Scavs will not spawn.

 

On the Ground Zero map, they appear opposite the Terragroup building.

the-guide.name: The guide
the-guide.html:
To complete the quest, you must achieve the "Survived" status on every location in a row without dying.

This means you need to gain at least 600 experience before extracting, or stay in the raid for at least 7 minutes.

For example: kill three Scavs and loot them, collect a lot of valuable items, or kill a PMC carrying many items.

It is recommended to kill three Scavs, loot them, and leave the location.

The quest is best done at night, when the chance of encountering enemies is lower.

It’s also strongly recommended to have a Library built in your Hideout, as it provides +15% bonus experience in raids.

Tip: start with Factory, Ground Zero, and Lab, as these are the most PvP-heavy maps. On Lab, it's better to extract using elevators — Raiders spawn upon elevator activation and must be killed.

Map-to-map transitions are now available. You can move to the next map just one minute after starting the raid. All visited locations will count if you survive and earn more than 600 XP.

Strategy: join empty servers (choose those with high ping or in regions where players are asleep). Enter raids with your best gear but no backpack (to reduce weight and visibility). Wear a helmet with a face shield to avoid getting shot in the eyes by Scavs. Bring some food. If you want to attempt this all in one go, take

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
. Also bring 30,000 rubles for vehicles or emergency extractions.

Suggested full route: Ground Zero → Streets of Tarkov → Laboratory → Streets of Tarkov → Interchange → Customs → Factory → Woods → Reserve → Lighthouse → Shoreline.

You can extract at any point if needed. Only the maps where you survived will count. Any missing locations can be completed later.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.html:
You need to kill Shturman 20 times.

Shturman spawns at the lumber mill with a chance of about 30%, along with two guards — the Svetloozersky brothers.

Shturman, like Reshala, does not wear armor. The guards may have armor up to a Zhuk-6a, but they don’t wear helmets.

They try not to stay close to each other and keep their distance from the player.

Shturman can be found at the lumber mill in Woods. He has two sniper guards. It’s useless to fight them at medium or long range — they are very accurate shooters. The best tactic is to carefully approach from the lakeside, from the area with the log shed, checking every corner, and kill him at close range. You can also catch them while they are retreating. They behave foolishly when the enemy is right next to them.

psycho-sniper.name: Psycho Sniper
psycho-sniper.html:
ATTENTION! If you have killed 5 PMCs but your sniper rifle mastery is not yet level ten, any death can reset your completed kill progress. Therefore, it is recommended to complete the second part only after reaching level ten in sniper mastery to immediately turn in the quest.

 

To reach level ten in sniper rifle mastery, it is recommended to reach level two through reloading and hitting with bolt-action rifles, then complete the quests:

The Tarkov shooter - Part 8
(or
Mentor
) and
A Shooter Born in Heaven

 

Buy

Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Infantry)
and several packs of ammunition. Head to any location

 

As soon as you spawn, just press the reload button. A round will eject from the chamber onto the ground and the character will chamber another

 

Try to hit Scavs as much as possible. Preferably don’t kill them right away. Shoot at legs and arms

 

In patch 1.0, the lever-action Marlin rifle was added. It is a bolt-action rifle and is excellent for completing the task.

 

For the part of the quest involving killing, you need to kill 5 PMC players in one life, which can be done in different raids. After the kills, you must exit the raid alive. It is recommended to take

Molot Arms VPO-215 Gornostay .366 TKM bolt-action rifle
with the round
.366 TKM AP-M

test-drive-part-6.name: Test-drive - Part 6
test-drive-part-6.html:
The first assault rifle will be given with the starting gear.

 

Equip the available gear and head to Customs . Both Scavs and PMCs are counted for the quest.

 

After loading into the map, if you spawn near the Scav spawn point, you can wait 1-2 minutes for the first waves of bots to appear.

 

Most of them spawn near the reservoir and buildings nearby See the spawn zone markers for bots , but be careful, the boss Reshala may appear at the gas station.

Водохранилище

Водохранилище

 

After that, you can check Another bot spawn zone , near the old construction site, in the hangars nearby, and near the Blockpost of the Russian Federation Armed Forces exit.

Старая стройка

Старая стройка

 

If you are not afraid of PvP, you can also visit Three-story dormitory , but be careful as there is another Reshala boss spawn there.

old-patterns.html:
The task is quite straightforward. Hand over 15

Physical Bitcoin
to the Fence. It is not necessary to find them in raid. After that, you will receive expanded pockets (ONLY FOR Edge of Darkness Limited Edition owners) for your character. However, you need to restart the game for them to appear.

.

dangerous-props.name: Dangerous props
dangerous-props.html:
Get the starting gear from the Skier and go to any location to kill 20 targets.

If you have lost the shotgun, you can buy it from the Skier again

For faster execution, locations are recommended: Reserve, Tarkov Streets, Epicenter

stray-dogs.name: Stray Dogs
stray-dogs.html:
Bosses roam between locations and change their spawn points from time to time. You can see their current location at the top of the website.

They have a lot of health and wear high-class armor, but their heads are often poorly protected. If they spot you, they will pursue you. Take cover behind an obstacle or enter a building—they are likely to follow you all together.

Find the Rogue bosses in Lighthouse

escort.name: Escort
escort.html:
You need to eliminate 4 PMCs on multiple maps without dying.

 

It’s recommended to start with The Lab , Factory (Daytime), and Ground Zero , as these are small maps with high PvP activity.

 

Playing in a group is a viable tactic — trade teammates for information if needed.

 

The Lab : Most fights happen near keycard-locked rooms.
Factory : Encounters usually occur in offices and basements.
Ground Zero : Players are often found in the Terragroup building.
Shoreline : Focus on the Health Resort and Norvinsk yacht club.
Woods : Many beginners spawn early near the EMERCOM camp and USEC base.
Interchange : Players loot electronics stores early on; some head for the no-backpack extract.
Reserve : PMCs often camp the D-2 lever room and the extract itself.
Customs : Common PMC locations include dorms, the library, and the construction site where Reshala spawns.

 

If a gunfight happens indoors or at close range, peek from your right side. The more rotations you make around the map, the higher your chances of running into bush campers. The more sub-objectives you've completed, the more passively you should play.

 

Below are PMC spawn maps — helpful if you decide to play aggressively and intercept players early in the raid:

night-sweep.name: Night Sweep
night-sweep.html:
Cultist knife
only drops from Cultists, but it may not be there. Cultists only appear at night on the following maps: Shoreline , Woods , Customs , Factory (Nighttime), and Ground Zero (after level 20). From approximately 23:00 to 06:00.

 

Spawn chance is higher on Shoreline , Woods , and Customs . On Factory and Ground Zero they are almost impossible to find. Cultists are a boss. A group consists of four cultists and the leader Priest. At sunrise they despawn (disappear). Other bosses can prevent Cultists from spawning (for example, if Reshala spawns at construction, Cultists won’t appear until Reshala and his guards are fully eliminated).

 

They usually sit or lie in bushes waiting for someone to approach. They first attack with a knife, but if you shoot them first or kill their leader, they immediately open fire. If you kill the entire group, the Priest may try to blow himself up with a grenade.

 

On the Customs map, you can kill them by holding the sarcophagus building. It’s very convenient to use cover inside. One advantage is that they will sometimes push you indoors.

 

At long range, there’s little point engaging them without a thermal scope (they are visible through thermal optics).

 

On Shoreline , it is recommended to kill them near the hydroelectric station. Just climb the nearby hill and shoot them from above. Keep more than 100 meters away from them.
You can also try to kill them at the sanatorium. Sometimes they appear inside on the first floor and outside, except for the admin building. They can also be found at the flooded village.

 

The Woods location is highly discouraged for killing Cultists. Large open spaces, bushes, and trees make it nearly impossible to fight them effectively.

 

On the Factory map, they appear in all locations where Scavs can spawn. They can be in the basement or offices. If Cultists are in the raid, Scavs will not spawn.

 

On the Ground Zero map, they appear opposite the Terragroup building.

new-beginning.name: New beginning
new-beginning.html:
Escape from Tarkov. Prestige. How to get prestige in Tarkov? Article updated on 14.05.2026 ... 05.01.25

For the First Prestige:

To complete the quest, you need to kill 50 Scavs. You can do this on any location that is convenient for you.

You need to survive once on the Laboratory location.

The figurines you need to hand in can be found by yourself or bought on the flea market; they do not need the "found in raid" mark.

See jewel spawn locations on Labs


After completing these quests and reaching character level 25, you should gain access to the First Prestige.


For the Second Prestige:

Now you need to kill 15 PMCs on any location.

Again, you need to survive on the Laboratory location.

This time, you need to find all the figurines in raid that were previously required without the "found in raid" mark, so you can't just buy them. You can start collecting them in advance.

See jewel spawn locations on Labs


You must complete the story quest chains

Tour
and
Falling Skies
.
After completing these quests and reaching character level 30, you should gain access to the Second Prestige.

For the third prestige:

To complete, you need to kill 25 PMCs on any location.

You also need to kill 50 raiders. The easiest way to do this is on the the-lab location, using the raider call via buttons. 
Find the raider call buttons on the the-lab location
You also need to collect the figures that were before, and also find any one figure from the Labyrinth. (At the moment, a figurine from the Labyrinth is not required, this condition has been removed from the game)
See the spawn of jewels on the lab

Find the transition to the Labyrinth on Shoreline
Find possible spawn locations of figurines in the Labyrinth

It is necessary to use the transition from the-lab to streets-of-tarkov and survive on the streets-of-tarkov location 
Find the transition to streets-of-tarkov on the the-lab

You must complete the story quest chains

Tour
and
Falling Skies
.
After completing these quests and reaching character level 35, access to the Third Prestige should be unlocked.

For the Fourth Prestige: 
To complete it, you need to kill 25 PMC’s on any location.

You also need to kill 100 Rogues. Rogues appear at the Lighthouse location at the water treatment plant.

You also need to collect the figurines that were there before, and also find any one figurine from the Labyrinth. (At the moment, a figurine from the Labyrinth is not required, this condition has been removed from the game)
See the spawn of valuables in the Lab
Find the transition to the Labyrinth on the Shoreline  
Find possible figurine spawn locations in the Labyrinth

You need to use the transition from the Laboratory to the streets-of-tarkov and survive in the streets-of-tarkov location Find the transition to the streets-of-tarkov in the Laboratory

You must complete the story quest chain

Tour
and obtain the case from the story quest
The Ticket
.
After completing these quests and reaching character level 40, access to the Fourth Prestige should be unlocked.

For the Fifth Prestige:
 

To complete it, you need to eliminate 45 PMCs on any location.

You also need to eliminate 100 Rogues. Rogues spawn at the Lighthouse location, at the water treatment plant.

You still need to collect the figurines required previously. (The requirement to find a figurine from the Labirint has been removed from the game as of now).
View valuable item spawns on The Lab
Find the transition to the Labirint on Shoreline
Find possible figurine spawn locations in the Labyrinth


Next, WITHOUT DYING, you must visit 4 locations in sequence and successfully extract from Customs.


You must use the transition from The Lab to Streets of Tarkov.
Find the transition to Streets of Tarkov on The Lab


After transitioning to Streets of Tarkov, you must transition to Interchange.
Find the transition to Interchange on Streets of Tarkov


After transitioning to Interchange, you must transition to Customs.
Find the transition to Customs on Interchange


On Customs, you must survive and extract from the raid.
Find the PMC extraction points on Customs


You also need to complete the quest

Collector
, the story quest chains
Tour
and
They Are Already Here
, and obtain the case from the story quest
The Ticket
.
After completing these quests and reaching character level 47, access to the Fifth Prestige should be unlocked.


For the sixth prestige:
To complete it, you need to kill 50 PMCs on any location.

You also need to kill 100 Rogues. Rogues spawn on the Lighthouse location at the water treatment plant.

You need to find and kill any boss with a headshot. The easiest will be to kill Tagilla on Factory . Bring ammunition with high penetration and a weapon with a high rate of fire.
Find Tagilla's Spawn Points on Factory

You need to kill 5 Cultists. They can only be found at night from 23:00 to 5:00. It's most convenient to search for them on Customs, but they are also on Shoreline and Ground Zero.

As guards and bosses all have good ammo, it is recommended to take high-tier armor, such as Altyn, Slick, Hexgrid. Also, your ammo should be able to penetrate 5+ armor class: BS, Igolnik, M61, M995, SNB

The hardest bosses are: Glukhar because he has the biggest group of guards, and Killa because many players with “The stylish one” quest want to kill him, and the boss himself is dangerous with his aggressive AI and great equipment.

consolation-prize.name: Consolation Prize
consolation-prize.html:
You prepare for the raid with the best gear, buy keycards to access the Laboratory, and run multiple raids.

Completing this quest grants you an achievement.

This is a high-level quest that rewards you with a variety of useful (and not so useful) skills.

After completing it, you'll unlock a repeatable weekly quest (presumably refreshing every week) where, for 20 million rubles, you receive a random skill boost.

a-friend-among-strangers.name: A friend among strangers
a-friend-among-strangers.html: The fastest and easiest way to complete this quest is on the Factory map. Put on your best gear and weapons and go hunt PMCs. Do not touch Scavs—killing them will fail the quest.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.html:
You can get this status with

Cultist knife

You can get wounded with this item by cultists
Cultist and Priest spawn locations are marked on the maps
At night on Factory
On Shoreline
In Woods
On Customs

There is a way to cheese the quest — ask your friend to buy

Cultist knife
on the flea market and stab you once. Recommended location is Factory at night
The Toxin effect does not start instantly, but about 10 seconds after the hit. After getting the effect you can safely extract and heal at Therapist — the quest will already be done, no need to worry

small-business-1.html:

On the Tarkov.Help map, these spots are called “Valuables.”

A couple of recommended locations (be careful, these are the most valuable and also the most dangerous spots):
Valuables and top loot in Laboratory
Valuables and top loot on Streets of Tarkov

On the Streets, there is a great valuables key. It has only 2 uses, but you can find the key itself with a 100% spawn chance in this building:
on the map
The room the key opens

small-business-2.html:
The easiest way to do this is on Streets of Tarkov. There is the most room to maneuver and lots of guards. You also won’t confuse Kaban with other bots — he has a big machine gun and swears loudly
Additionally, you can check the Police Academy or Klimov Shopping Mall to look for Kollontay and his guards

establish-contact.html: To reach 4.0 reputation it is recommended to play as Scav on Factory more often and use all possible paid car extracts as PMC as many times as possible

war-war-never-changes.name: War... war never changes
war-war-never-changes.html:
The quest unlocks after completing

Boreas
at the point of killing the Wedge bosses and finding the ship's captain.


Open the server room door and find three special disks inside.
Take the disks and return to the Mechanic in the shelter.


You'll inform the Mechanic that the captain is dead and the scientist won't tell you anything (he's waiting for the APC to complete the mission).
The Mechanic will update the mission and tell you to collect new electronics and bring them to him.


At the same time, you'll be given four missions to complete on the Icebreaker.
Search for items and equipment. These reward a lot of money and good gear.
 

You need to find 10 special Noobie Shield potassium iodide tablets.

They often spawn on the Icebreaker in various rooms at medical spawn locations.

Can be done over several raids.

updating-the-assortment.name: Updating the assortment
updating-the-assortment.html:
The quest unlocks after completing

Boreas
at the point of killing the Wedge bosses and finding the ship's captain.

Open the server room door and find three special disks inside.
Take the disks and return to the Mechanic in the shelter.
You'll inform the Mechanic that the captain is dead and the scientist won't tell you anything (he's waiting for the APC to complete the mission).
The Mechanic will update the mission and tell you to collect new electronics and bring them to him.
At the same time, you'll be given four missions to complete on the Icebreaker.
Search for items and equipment. These reward a lot of money and good gear.

 

You need to find 5 Black Division armor vests and extract them from the raid. Can be done over several raids.

The reward unlocks the helmet

Rys-T bulletproof helmet (Black)
.

 

If you are confident in your abilities or playing in a group, take huge backpacks to bring out more at once.

fight-fire-with-fire.name: Fight fire with fire
fight-fire-with-fire.html:
The quest unlocks after completing

Boreas
at the point of killing the Wedge bosses and finding the ship's captain.


Open the server room door and find three special disks inside.
Take the disks and return to the Mechanic in the shelter.
You'll inform the Mechanic that the captain is dead and the scientist won't tell you anything (he's waiting for the APC to complete the mission).
The Mechanic will update the mission and tell you to collect new electronics and bring them to him.
At the same time, you'll be given four missions to complete on the Icebreaker.
Search for items and equipment. These reward a lot of money and good gear.
 

You need to kill all four Wedge bots, or kill them 4 times. This can be done over several raids on the Icebreaker.

You need to bring out one of the Wedge rigs from the raid to hand over to Jaeger.

 

The quest gives you a sniper rifle and ammunition for it.

 

It might unlock some other quests — we are checking.

biochemistry.name: Biochemistry
biochemistry.html:
These expensive items appear only on the Icebreaker map.

This is a 2x2 item that costs 1 million rubles per unit.

You need to find it in raid.

 

This item appears in locked rooms that require keycards to open, or can be found randomly at medical spawn locations.

As soon as you find this item, we recommend leaving the location and extracting it from the raid.

 

Completing the quest will unlock the ability to purchase

Money case
.

release-escape-from-tarkov-10.html:
From here we will be adding the quests for the release version of Escape from Tarkov.

For now, the quest line is under the trader Prapor.

If new traders appear, we will label inside each quest which trader it belongs to.

The next quests in the chain are:  

Tour
- Starting quest  
Falling Skies
- Unlocks after Mechanic, need to find the Plane on Woods. A CHOICE!
They Are Already Here
- Open the marked room on Customs  
Batya
- Find the patch on Customs  
Accidental witness
- Need to approach the car near the dorms on Customs

Blue Fire
- Woods, EMERCOM camp, note
The Unheard
- Streets of Tarkov, Cardinal Residential Complex, TerraGroup security office, note
Labyrinth
- Shoreline, Labyrinth entrance

The Ticket
- Continued after selection in
Falling Skies
. A CHOICE!

The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior"
,
The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen"
,
The Ticket. Lightkeeper. "Stay in Tarkov"
,
The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"

Terminal Walkthrough Guide. In this article, we'll explain how to complete the story Escape from Tarkov ... 03.12.25

tour.name: Tour
tour.html:
Everything starts with the tutorial. You need to get out of the Epicenter map.

You appear on a modified version of the Epicenter map. There will be no players on this map.

You get up from the floor and look around – hints are enabled for you. Collect the items around you.

Medicine, food, weapons. Carefully inspect tables, crates and corpses, as well as the area around the corpses. They have weapons, ammo and cassettes for your player.

 

When you have collected everything you need in the starting location, move further down the corridor – Scavs will be waiting for you there (these are hostile enemy bots that will shoot at you).

Carefully kill them, don’t overexpose yourself. Move further toward the street.

Don’t forget to loot items from the dead bots.

Before exiting into the lobby, to the right of the corpses, do not miss

LEDX Skin Transilluminator
, this is an expensive and rare item, necessary for future quests:


Path to
LEDX Skin Transilluminator
: 

Route to Ledx. Part 1

Route to Ledx. Part 1

Route to LedX. Part 2

Route to LedX. Part 2

 

Route to LedX. Part 3

Route to LedX. Part 3

Route to LedX. Part 4

Route to LedX. Part 4


Route to LedX. Part 5

Route to LedX. Part 5

Route to LedX. Part 6

Route to LedX. Part 6



Go all the way to the end of the fence and extract from the location.

If you die in this location, that’s also an option, but the possible choices will be different.

 

After extracting, you need to talk to the Therapist and pay her 250,000 rubles. Sell extra items or gather them with the help of your Scav. The Streets of Tarkov map (access to this map) will be unlocked for you.

Then talk to Ragman. He will give you a quest to go to the Interchange map and explore it. There will already be players there. Basically, you just need to extract alive from the location. Use our convenient maps.

Find the exits on the Interchange map

The maps are being updated, but the standard exits from previous patches remain.

After extracting, talk to Ragman again. He will unlock a new trader for you, Skier.

 

Talk to Skier. He will give you a quest to find in raid 5 items from the Building Materials category. You can find them on any available location. We recommend the Interchange location – there are construction stores there.

Find the spawn locations of the required items

You will also unlock an additional quest and the Customs map. Go to this map and look for the exits.

Find the exits from Customs

Move carefully; there will be enemy players here. Collect items and building materials, kill bots, and extract from the location.

 

After surviving on Customs, return to Skier and he will unlock some exits/transitions for you, including to Factory.

When you hand over the Construction Materials, additional locations and transitions will also become available to you.

The next trader that will be unlocked for you is Mechanic. Visit him and talk to him to get new quests and tasks.

He will give you the following task — go to the Factory map, then survive and extract. Find the extraction points on the Factory map

Additionally, Mechanic will ask you to bring him Scav weapons. This will also unlock additional exits/transitions.

 

After surviving on Factory, talk to Mechanic again. He will unlock the Woods map for you and give you a task to go there.

In addition to the standard survival requirement, you will need to eliminate any 3 targets on this map. Extract after completing the kills.

Find the extraction points on the Woods map

 

After completing the quest on the Woods map, go and talk to Skier. He will direct you to the Shoreline map. Go to the Port, but do not get too close — they will most likely open fire on you.
Find the spot you need to approach

The next subtask will be to find a way to contact the military.

Spot near the checkpoint

Spot near the checkpoint

The spot you need to approach in order to mark the Port.

The spot you need to approach in order to mark the Port.

 

In the same area near the bus, there will be a tower. Under the tower, you’ll find a console — press it and the sub-task will update. Now you need to talk to the traders in your Hideout.

Same marker as above nearby

The way to contact the military is located under the guard tower.

The way to contact the military is located under the guard tower.

 

You can receive an additional task if you find

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
in a raid. In this case, you will need to go to the Laboratory map. We are clarifying the next steps. As optional objectives, you will need to find the entrances to the Laboratory on the Factory and Streets of Tarkov maps.

Find the Laboratory entrance on Factory

Find the Laboratory entrance on Streets of Tarkov

 

On the Laboratory map, your quest may update.

You need to inspect the top managers’ offices (presumably the transparent room locked with a key), inspect the server room, and the extraction point in the drainage area.

Find the locations on the Laboratory map

 

You need to figure out how to escape from Tarkov.

WARNING! YOU CAN ACCIDENTALLY FAIL THIS QUEST IF YOU TALK TO OTHER TRADERS AFTER RECEIVING IT.

After talking to the traders, you will learn from Mechanic that you need to deliver 20,000 dollars to him.

You also need to go into a raid on the Shoreline map and successfully survive.

Getting such a large amount of money will be difficult, but Peacemaker has become available to you (without a quest, but you can sell items and equipment for dollars).

 

Either because of failing the quest, or simply by progression, or due to talking to traders, you will receive 3 new objectives:

Gain access to the Reserve map – you need to bring Prapor 5 PMC dogtags from a raid.

Gain access to the Lighthouse map – you need to pay Mechanic 20,000 dollars.
Gain access to the Streets of Tarkov map (you already have this one, since you paid Therapist earlier)

Continue completing the sub-tasks to unlock new missions.

 

After unlocking all locations and exploring the Laboratory, this storyline will be completed.

falling-skies.name: Falling Skies
falling-skies.html:
This quest becomes available immediately after completing Mechanic’s sub-task for a successful extraction from the Factory map.

Otherwise, you can receive the quest by entering the Woods map and approaching the plane on your own.

First task. You need to go to the Woods map and find the plane.

Find the plane on the Woods map

There are many different items, food, and valuables lying around the plane.

 

Approach the plane, and after receiving the completion notification for the quest, proceed to extract from the location.

Task two.

Talk to the Therapist.

She will give you two tasks — give her 2,000 dollars and find the flash drive.

You may already have the dollars; if not, complete the quest Tour until you unlock Peacemaker. After that, sell items to him for dollars.

 

The flash drive is located on the Shoreline map near the Tunnel extraction.

Flash drive under the car wheel. View from farther away

Flash drive under the car wheel. View from farther away

Flash drive under the car wheel

Flash drive under the car wheel

USB flash drive on the car suspension

USB flash drive on the car suspension

Find the car on the Shoreline map

Hand the flash drive over to Prapor. Wait for some time (possibly a full real-life day).

The flash drive was decrypted in about 1 real hour. Return to Prapor and update the quest.

You need to find the Black Box on the Woods map and bring it to Shoreline.

Find the box in the plane

The box from a distance

The box from a distance

The box up close

The box up close

Then extract from the raid and start a new raid on the Shoreline map.

Head toward the destroyed tunnel, then cross over to the fishermen’s island using the barge. Go into the house and enter the farthest room. Plant the box and return to your Hideout.

Find the planting spot on Shoreline

The required house is reached by crossing the barge.

The required house is reached by crossing the barge.

The place where you need to plant the black box

The place where you need to plant the black box

Your next task is to find various components for Prapor.

Rechargeable battery
x3,
Printed circuit board
x5, and
Toolset
.

All of these can be found on the Interchange map, but really anywhere. The toolbox can be crafted or traded.

 

After handing over all the items, Prapor will ask you to wait for some time. After waiting, he will tell you to go to the Shoreline map and search the chairman’s house (for example

Courtesy visit
) to find a diary with data and a flash drive. Take them and bring them to your Hideout.

Find the required house

A flash drive from afar

A flash drive from afar

One of the flash drive spawn locations. On the plate or nearby.

One of the flash drive spawn locations. On the plate or nearby.

Transcript. View from a distance

Transcript. View from a distance

Transcript spawn under the mattress

Transcript spawn under the mattress

 

When talking to Prapor, a certain “ticket out of Tarkov” will be mentioned. You need to go to the Woods map again, to the same plane. Find the case in the pilot’s cockpit — on the seat or on the floor. Take it and bring it back to Prapor.

Find the location on the Woods map

The case is inside the plane on the floor to the left of the entrance.

The case is inside the plane on the floor to the left of the entrance.

The case is shaped like a long item.

The case is shaped like a long item.

 

After you bring the case to Prapor, you will have a choice — give the case to him as you agreed earlier, or keep it for yourself. THIS IS AN IMPORTANT CHOICE!

Each choice gives you an achievement, and the other one cannot be obtained in this playthrough.

“Man of His Word” – if you give the case to Prapor
“Just business” – if you kept the case.

 

ATTENTION! This choice affects which achievements you can earn. You can choose any outcome—you will not lock yourself out from completing any of the Storylines. However, the storylines related to Prapor

The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen"
and
The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"
will be more difficult if you kept the case for yourself. If you gave the case to Prapor, you will need to complete the Lightkeeper questline, but the Prapor endings
The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen"
and
The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"
will be easier.

 

Both choices may affect the next storyline

The Ticket
. You will need to build Recon Center level 1.

The storyline is complete.

they-are-already-here.name: They Are Already Here
they-are-already-here.html:
The quest starts if you enter any locked marked room, find a note in the marked circles, or kill a cultist.

A note for "They are already here" in the RB-BK marked room

A note for "They are already here" in the RB-BK marked room

A note for "They are already here" in the RB-PKPM marked room

You need to find a place connected to the Eye of the World.

 

Your path leads to the Lighthouse map. Unlock the map through the Tour quest. You need to go to the center of the map, in the flooded village.

Find the required house on the Lighthouse map

 

Enter the house and the sub-task will update. Inside, find the Key on the table and the cassette on the chair in the center. Take them and return to your Hideout. Be sure to listen to the cassette so the quest updates.

The key and the tape are in the sectarian room at the lighthouse

The key and the tape are in the sectarian room at the lighthouse

Find Cultists on Customs

The quest will update and your next task is to find three Eyes of the World.

Go to the lower cottage, the one with the large house and the nearby two-story garage. Enter the house, go to the second floor, and enter the room directly behind the staircase. Inside, there will be a room with cultist symbols. On the balcony near the mattress, you will find a note.

Take the items and leave the raid for your Hideout.

The next location is Shoreline.

Toolset

The body next to the tower

The body next to the tower

Enter the hut and hold the interact button. The sub-task will complete. Continue to the Woods map.

 

RAID ONLY DURING THE DAY, OTHERWISE THE NOTE WILL NOT APPEAR.

Attention! Two notes spawn on the board — one is Kerman’s note, and the other is the one required for this quest. They spawn in the same spot, so you must pick up one note, extract from the raid, then start a new raid and pick up the second (required) one. Both do not spawn at the same time as of 27.11.25.

On the Woods map, go to the north side, to the flooded village. Enter the house – the quest will update. Find the board with the note on it. Take it, examine it, and return to the Hideout.

Find the required house on the Woods map

A board with a note inside the house
