The Sectarians' note itself

 

Talk to Mechanic. He will give you a flash drive (a regular one

Secure Flash drive
) and unlock the craft for the 14-4 KORD pass in the Recon Center.

You found the pass earlier. Here is the information again:

Go to the quad bike and pick up the quest pass. It may always spawn there, but grab it just in case.

Find the quad bike on the Lighthouse map

D14 pass near garages

D14 pass near garages

 

Crafting will take around 8 hours. After that, you must collect the finished item and head to Interchange. Bring money for the paid extraction!

Don’t forget to take the Pass you crafted, as well as the

Secure Flash drive
.

Go to the power substation. Activate the power lever.

Find the lever on the Interchange map

After activating it, find the door right behind the lever, open it, and go down into the basement. There, use the keycard to enter.

Locked door for the KORD-14 keycard.

Locked door for the KORD-14 keycard.

 

Find the location you need to reach

First, immediately after entering, activate the server room power. Then go further and activate the cooling. In the same room, plant the flash drive you brought with you.

Return to the main room and take the cassette from the safe that has opened. Listen to it.

After opening the door, the power will be turned on to the left behind the door.

After opening the door, the power will be turned on to the left behind the door.

Activation of cooling in the server room.

Activation of cooling in the server room.

The safe will open after power is applied.

The safe will open after power is applied.

 

You now need to extract and survive on Interchange.

 

ATTENTION! IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR THE PLOT!

To complete the story line

The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior"
, you MUST eliminate the agents, i.e., obtain the secret achievement. Otherwise, Kerman will not cooperate with you, and you will get a different ending from Prapor involving collecting hundreds of millions of rubles.

 

Extract, then start another raid on Interchange and return to the same room. Bring money for the paid extraction!

Activate the power again, use the keycard, and enter the room once more.

To earn both achievements, follow the steps carefully:

Activate the power behind the door again, then the cooling in the far room.

Take the note from the main desk.

A note that tells you that there is a secret button.

A note that tells you that there is a secret button.

 

From it, you’ll learn about a secret button under the desk that disables the agents.

Find this button in the far room, under the desk opposite the cooling lever, and press it.

Turning off agents for a secret plot ending

Turning off agents for a secret plot ending

 

Then pick up the flash drive under the cooling lever.

Pick up the flash drive after turning off the agents

Pick up the flash drive after turning off the agents

 

You must extract and survive.

In your Hideout, you will receive the achievement “And the Light Went Out” – a secret one for disabling the agents.

Talk to Mechanic and give him the flash drive. He will send you a message; accept it and read the specification.

You will receive a second achievement, “Through Foreign Eyes.”

If the achievements do not appear, restart the game.

The storyline is complete.

After collecting and reading ALL the items, we head to the ambush spot on the Forest map, where we need to retrieve a code part, a phone, and Moreman's token.

After obtaining the phone, two cassette craftings will become available at the workbench. After listening to all the cassettes and reading all the notes, you need to build a Level 3 Intelligence Center. Once the Intelligence Center is built, the quest chain will continue. Before going to the Lightkeeper, you need to access the intelligence center's radio, select option 35.70, 27.893.2000 enter the frequency, and only then go to Lightkeeper. You will need to turn the Bogatrys' items over to Lightkeeper. 
The quest
Network Provider - Part 1
will also become available. Before completing this part, it is best to complete
Getting Acquainted
. This will help avoid bugs and having to revisit Lightkeeper. 

After gaining access to Lightkeeper, you need to gather the items listed below and hand them over to Lightkeeper: 
Streltsov's Amulet  
Voyevoda's Dictaphone  
Moreman's Token  
Taran's Postcard
Bogatrys' Patch


After handing over the items to the Lightkeeper and waiting 12 hours, Voyevoda will contact you via radio and give you a small test:

Kill 4 PMCs without dying once. After completing this challenge, you may die and it will not reset.

Kill 15 any targets without dying once. After completing this challenge, you may die and it will not reset.

To level up the "Strength" skill, we recommend constantly moving while overloaded by filling your backpack, for example with

MP-153 12ga 5-shell magazine
.

To level up the "Stress Resistance" skill, you can find a secluded spot with barbed wire and take damage from it (a burning barrel or simply jumping from a height also works), while simultaneously healing from the injuries. Stress Resistance levels up when your character takes damage.

To level up the "Assault Rifles" skill, kill any targets using weapons from this class. The most popular and accessible option is

Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle
.

To level up the "Light Machine Guns" skill, kill any targets using weapons from this class. The most popular and accessible option is

RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun
.

Don't forget that fatigue can impose an experience penalty on skill leveling. So try to gain a few points per raid and then start a new one.

Mysterious room marked key

the-ticket.name: The Ticket
the-ticket.html:
ATTENTION! We have created separate quests for completing each specific ending. Find them via search on the website, in the quest map, or click the links below:

The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior"
,
The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen"
The Ticket. Lightkeeper. "Stay in Tarkov"
The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"

 

This storyline quest begins when you install Intelligence Center level 1.

Kerman – the cat hacker – will contact you. The dialogue will depend on your decisions in

Falling Skies
.

 

Quest

Falling Skies
only affects the difficulty of passing through some storylines.

This means that if you give the case to Prapor, to complete

The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"
you will need to unlock the Lightkeeper, but in this case you will have to pay Prapor 300 million rubles, not 500 million rubles.

In any case, you will be able to achieve any ending; the case only affects the difficulty of the Prapor-based endings.

 

In this main storyline quest you will have 4 endings.

These are literally 4 different paths with completely different approaches.

We created 4 separate sub-quests with the names of the NPCs that work with you.

Here we outline them briefly, but you can always open those quests and study them in detail.

==========

The best ending is achieved by choosing Kerman

The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior"
.
This is the same hacker-cat you communicate with via the laptop in your Hideout.
Give the case to Prapor and later return it through the Lightkeeper.

While completing his tasks, you will learn a lot about TerraGroup.
You must always cooperate with him and help in every way. Complete ALL storyline chains.

To achieve the best ending, you must gather all incriminating evidence for his final quest.
This will help you:

Notes for completing the quest 100% Ticket for Kerman

Ending “Savior”.
You collected the evidence, successfully left Tarkov, and can now fight TerraGroup.

==========

The medium, neutral ending belongs to Prapor

The Ticket. Prapor. Fast ending. "The Survivor"
, if after opening the case you immediately refuse Kerman’s help.
In this scenario, the payment required will depend on whether you gave the case to Prapor in
Falling Skies
or not.

If you gave the case to Prapor, you must unlock the Lightkeeper and then pay Prapor 300 million rubles.
If you kept the case, you do NOT need to unlock the Lightkeeper, the story progresses faster, but you must pay 500 million rubles.
After paying, you must complete additional tasks — we are gathering data.

Ending “Survivor”.
You successfully left Tarkov, but TerraGroup remains unpunished.
But you don’t care, right?

==========

Neutral-bad ending via the Lightkeeper

The Ticket. Lightkeeper. "Stay in Tarkov"
. You can get this if you refuse to collect ALL the compromising materials for Kerman. You need to follow Kerman's path, but then refuse to collect all the compromising materials. Collect a little and refuse to collect it completely.

In

Falling Skies
you must give the case to Prapor, and then unlock the Lightkeeper through
Network Provider - Part 1
.
This will be a long quest chain through the Lightkeeper.
You will need to kill and gather items. Data will be updated.

Ending “Debtor”.
You successfully left Tark… Oh, wait—no.
In this ending, due to your debts to the Lightkeeper, you cannot leave Tarkov.
When attempting to depart by boat, you are brought back to repay your debts.

==========

Bad ending with Prapor, but via Kerman

The Ticket. Prapor. "Fallen"
. We follow the path of cooperation with Kerman, but at the very last moment when we are required to collect compromising materials on TerraGroup, we immediately refuse to collect them. Then we go to Prapor and receive expensive tasks from him, and in the end we need to collect 1 million dollars.

The "Fallen" ending.

Most likely, due to the "Bio-weapon" in this choice, this ending is considered not very good. We get shot and remain in Tarkov, while TerraGroup conquers the world.

==========

the-ticket-kerman.name: The Ticket. Kerman. "Savior"
the-ticket-kerman.html:
This storyline path is for Kerman the cat. This choice affects only his ending. The Lightkeeper ending is in another branch with different options.

Below are details, screenshots, and links.

Short summary of what you will definitely need:

– In quest

Falling Skies
we recommend giving the case to Prapor. This unlocks
Network Provider - Part 1
, which is required for
Batya
.
– Look for the items needed for
Network Provider - Part 1
.
– Start saving 40x
Physical Bitcoin
.
– Look for or buy
TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
.
– Look for or buy Marked keys. They are needed for “Clean RFID card”.
– Raise Fence reputation. First to 1.0+, then to 4.0+.
– Complete the BTR Driver quests starting with
A helping hand
. Needed to raise reputation.
– Upgrade your Hideout up to Solar Power level 1.

 

Full walkthrough:

This storyline quest starts when you build Recon Center level 1.

Kerman — the cat hacker — will contact you. The dialogue depends on the choices you made in

Falling Skies
.

He may get angry and you’ll need to wait until he calms down (timer), or you talk normally and he sends you to Mechanic to learn how to open the case.

 

Variant:

If you gave the case to Prapor but read the transcript from the previous quest, Kerman will be slightly angry but then will send you to Lighthouse to find Prapor’s people’s camp.

Go to the camp near the Chalet — above the road, up the hill. There is a camp with a note. Take the note and return.

The Lighthouse camp where the note for Kerman is located

The Lighthouse camp where the note for Kerman is located

A note in the camp

A note in the camp

Another note spawn location in the same camp.

Another note spawn location in the same camp.

 

Talk to Kerman. He will point you toward the Lightkeeper.

Now you must unlock access to the Lightkeeper. To start quest

Network Provider - Part 1
you need Fence reputation above 1.0.

After finishing the quest chain to unlock the Lightkeeper, especially

Getting Acquainted
, go to him on Lighthouse and talk (default third dialogue line).

The Lightkeeper will tell you he needs three

TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
. Don’t take extra tasks if you want only the storyline.

The storyline won’t update yet. The dialogue repeats (a bug). Talk once and leave. Return to your Hideout. Finish Mechanic’s quest about the Lightkeeper. Then the storyline progresses (you may need to relog).

You can buy

TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
on the Flea Market or find them on Labs.

Put the documents in your secure container and return to Lighthouse.

 

Give the documents to the Lightkeeper and receive a new task.

 

You must fire a yellow flare on Interchange near ULTRA main entrance and kill anyone who arrives. Most likely no one will arrive, so simply roam and kill any targets.

Buy

RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)
, put it in the special slot. Load into Interchange, fire the flare into the sky by ULTRA main entrance.

The task updates.

Kill 15 targets of any type. Do not die or leave the map. One attempt, otherwise the mission restarts.

Finish it and return to the Lightkeeper to turn it in.

Talk to him and receive the quest case. Free your special slot.

Next you must open the case.

 

Kerman will send you to Mechanic. Mechanic will tell you to find an “Experimental Signal Suppressor” on Labs.

It spawns in the Lecture Hall — on tables where the audience sits, and on the podium.

Signal suppressor in the lecture hall

Signal suppressor in the lecture hall

 

Another spawn is on the new medical area tables.

Signal suppressor on a new area

Signal suppressor on a new area

 

After finding the “Signal Suppressor”, return to Mechanic. He gives further instructions.

You will get a craft on the Workbench — the lock will take over two days to open.

After opening it you’ll receive a full case in your stash (free space required). Inside:

– Lots of Euros
– A random keycard
– A special RFID card registered to Kruglov — your quest item
– A new mail letter — study it

 

Talk to Kerman.

 

If you choose to cooperate with Kerman, you get several tasks:

Find the “RFID card encryption device”.
Find the “Master Lab Pass”.
Activate Kruglov’s RFID card.

 

Requirements:
– Access to Streets of Tarkov (from the Tour storyline)
– Find Kruglov’s apartment on Streets
– Access to Labs
– Visit Kruglov’s office on Labs
– Optional: Solar Power in the Hideout
– Find a “Clean RFID card”

You also unlock a new craft.

 

The Master Pass can be found in the new Kruglov room inside a safe.

Entry requires

TerraGroup Labs access keycard
and at least 2 charges of
TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
. One charge for the room, one for the safe.

Inside is the pass — a quest item. If you die, you must recover it again. Extract and transfer it to your inventory via the quest interface so it can’t be lost.

 

A “Clean RFID-card” can be found in Marked Rooms. Confirmed in

Dorm room 314 marked key
.

 

If you give up searching for the encryption device or fail the quest (wandering Labs too long), Mechanic will message you and a timer begins.

Important: to push the quest forward you must survive three Labs raids in a row for 10+ minutes each.

 

After roughly 30 hours, talk to Mechanic again. He will say he needs 40x

Physical Bitcoin
. You can find them or barter from Mechanic every 2 hours.

Trader

Items

Result item

Trader
Items
x2
x2
Result item

 

After giving him the Bitcoins, you get the Elektronik key with 20 charges. It grants access to the apartment on Streets. If you lose it, you can barter it for 1 Bitcoin.

Go to the building near the Labyrinth transition on Streets. Unlock the door, go through the hallway into the room. The encryption device is under the desk.

Path to the required apartment Electronics 1

Path to the required apartment Electronics 1

Path to the required apartment Electronics 2

Path to the required apartment Electronics 2

The needed apartment is inside the building, on the right.

The needed apartment is inside the building, on the right.

Inside the room under the table

Inside the room under the table

The encoder up close under the table

The encoder up close under the table

 

Take it into your secure container and extract. In the Hideout, use Recon Center to craft the activated key. Craft time is over 48 hours — watch your fuel.

 

After the craft, use the resulting keycard on Shoreline at the same location where it was used in the Tour storyline.

Use the keycard, the task updates. Extract and talk to Kerman.

 

Now you must gather incriminating materials against TerraGroup — you probably already have some.

You need 8 major incriminating items and 32 minor ones.

Major items are completed storyline quests.
Minor ones are extra notes, tapes, blueprint books. They may affect the ending. If you collect all 32, you get an achievement.

Minor items list is in

Notes for completing the quest 100% Ticket for Kerman
.

 

Storylines required:

Tour

Falling Skies

They Are Already Here

Batya

Accidental witness

Blue Fire

The Unheard

Labyrinth

 

After collecting all incriminating materials (or most of them), talk to Kerman and tell him everything is ready. He will explain that your map had incorrect hash codes and that you must wait for his courier.

Then you’ll receive the special container “Alpha-1” in messages.

 

After about 48 hours, Fence will contact you. He’ll say he doesn’t trust you (if your reputation is too low) and will require raising your reputation to 4.0. You can raise it by successful Scav raids, killing PMCs as a Scav, using Co-op extractions (PMC + Scav), paid PMC extractions, and daily tasks.

 

After reaching 4.0+ you get a new task — extract with a Scav on the Co-op exit on Woods and Reserve (in PvE you must kill a PMC instead).


 

Then you must raise reputation with the BTR Driver. He spawns on Woods and Streets.

Do quests in the BTR Driver chain

A helping hand
and Prapor’s connected quests until
The Price of Independence
.

 

After finishing the BTR Driver chain, the task updates. You must build Solar Power level 1 in the Hideout. You need

Advanced current converter
, found only on Labs or rewarded in
Trouble in the Big City
.

 

After building it, you must craft the RFID card with Kerman's hash codes. Craft time about 12 hours — watch your fuel.

After crafting the card, you can enter the Terminal.

 

Warning: take either the cheapest gear (and loot inside the Terminal), or the best gear with class 6 armor and eye protection. When entering, everything will be taken from you. You must gather supplies in the starting house. Later you may retrieve your gear in the Arsenal, but it requires time and a key.

 

Attention! If you die inside the Terminal zone, you will be allowed to make another attempt, but you will have to craft Kruglov’s keycard again — each craft takes 12 hours. Make sure to farm as many “Clean RFID cards” as possible.

 

Go to the intercom on Shoreline:

Use the keycard. A cutscene starts and you enter the Terminal.

 

BE SURE TO TAKE THE "ALPHA-1" CONTAINER WITH YOU. Even if you die, it will be returned to you in your messages.

This is the best ending of all the storylines.

===============================================
